comment: R16 P1 item 3: the literal R11-R14 friction lines and the floor lines of the brief, as named cases, run through the real adapter (index.ts tool_call, overlayBlock) with a stubbed reviewer. Placeholders, filled by r16-auto-review.test.ts: {sid} the foreman session id, {id} a bg task id, {run} an async run id, {tmp} the test's TMPDIR stand-in, {H} the own handoff dir (the chair writes rulings there; the session is its child), {C} another handoff dir where the session is the child, {agentDir} the agent dir (also for a leading ~/.pi/agent), {other} another session id. Every path is passed through inBash. expect: pass = no overlay decision (no dialog, no model call); allow = an overlay ask the auto reviewer decides (no dialog with an allowing stub); dialog = a selfMod ask (human dialog, no model call); refused = the self_ruling guard (ruling.ts) refuses it before the overlay (no dialog, no model call); deny = a deterministic overlay deny (no model call). selfMod (ruling 2): a protect ask hit on a shell write/remove target or a write tool's path; a protected path a shell line only reads or mentions goes to the reviewer.
